python3 - <<'PY'
import base64
import json
import subprocess


def expect(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        raise AssertionError(msg)

repo = 'repos/organvm-iii-ergon/collaboration-operations-platform'
repo_meta = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', repo], text=True))
expect(repo_meta.get('private') is True, 'repo must be private')
expect(repo_meta.get('default_branch') == 'main', 'default branch must be main')

commits = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', '--paginate', f'{repo}/commits'], text=True))
genesis = next(
    c for c in commits if c.get('commit', {}).get('message', '').startswith('genesis: collaboration-operations-platform')
)
seed = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/seed.yaml'], text=True))
seed_text = base64.b64decode(seed['content']).decode('utf-8')
expect('docs/continuations/collaboration-operations-platform-alpha-20260802/workstream.json' in seed_text, 'seed.yaml evidence path must match alpha-20260802 workstream')
expect('scripts/repo-genesis.py' in seed_text, 'seed.yaml must record repo-genesis provenance')

brainstorms = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/brainstorms/platform.yaml'], text=True))
b_text = base64.b64decode(brainstorms['content']).decode('utf-8')
expect('platform:' in b_text, 'seed brainstorm file missing platform block')

outside = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/collaborators?affiliation=outside&per_page=100'], text=True))
expect(outside == [], 'outside collaborators must be absent')
print('PASS: beta-02 foundation predicates validated; genesis', genesis['sha'][:8])
PY

outcome: Verified that collaboration-operations-platform was minted with repo-genesis seed artifacts, private visibility, main default branch, genesis commit, and no outside collaborators.
